title: Article 122 Article 122  A voidable act may not be rescinded after the person prescribed in Article 120 ratifies it.
statute_text:
Article 122 Article 122  A voidable act may not be rescinded after the person prescribed in Article 120 ratifies it.
(Method of Voidance and Ratification)

variables.description: The act of ratifying a voidable act.
The specific person defined in Article 120 who has the authority to ratify or rescind an act.

predicates.description: The person prescribed in Article 120 ratifies the voidable act.
predicates.supporting_span: the person prescribed in Article 120 ratifies it

predicates.description: A voidable act may not be rescinded after ratification.
predicates.supporting_span: A voidable act may not be rescinded after the person prescribed in Article 120 ratifies it.

rules.supporting_span: A voidable act may not be rescinded after the person prescribed in Article 120 ratifies it.
rules.explanation: A voidable act cannot be rescinded once ratified by the specified person.
